intro.pitch: I turn long videos into short clips people actually watch. Let's get your first ones made.
intro.pitchFree: I turn long videos into short clips people actually watch. Your first one's on me, no card needed.

reply.podcasts: Love it. Podcasts are full of moments that travel on their own: one sharp answer can reach more people than the whole episode.
reply.streams: Nice. Hours of stream hide a handful of moments people would share. Finding them is my job.
reply.youtube: Great. Your best minutes deserve a second life as Shorts, Reels and TikToks.
reply.talks: Perfect. A good talk has a few lines people will quote. I find them and cut them clean.
reply.other: Nice. Whatever it is, if people talk in it, I can find the moments worth sharing.

intro.offer: Want to see what your own video turns into?
intro.offerFree: Want to see yours? Paste a link and I'll make your best clip, free.
intro.showcase: Here's a taste: a few clips I made from real podcast episodes, each in a different style.

plans.label: Plans
plans.proExtra: Captions, B-roll and your own fonts
plans.creatorExtra: Agent does it all for you, plus scheduling
plans.ctaUnlock: Unlock {count, plural, one {the other clip} other {the other # clips}}

link.elsewhere: Your first clip starts on the create screen.
link.paste: Paste a link to one of your videos up here, or upload a file, then hit the arrow.
link.pasteFree: Paste a link to one of your videos up here, or upload a file. I'll make your best clip for free, no card needed.
link.lookFailed: I couldn't open that link. Check that it's public and try again?
link.estimate: {count, plural, one {About one clip in here} other {About # clips in here}}
link.free: Got it, {runtime} long. I can see about {count, plural, one {one clip} other {# clips}} in there. Hit the arrow and I'll make the best one for you, free.
link.paid: Got it, {runtime} long, about {count, plural, one {one clip} other {# clips}} in there. Hit the arrow and I'll get started.

refused.tooLong: This one's {runtime}. Free clips work on videos up to {minutes} minutes, so try a shorter one, or pick a plan and I'll clip the whole thing.
refused.used: You've already had your free clip. Pick a plan and I'll clip this one in full.
refused.running: Your free clip is already being made. I'll let you know when it's ready.
refused.busy: Free clips are paused for today, sorry. Pick a plan and I'll start on this right away.
refused.unverified: Confirm your email first (check your inbox), then paste the link again. Your free clip's waiting.
refused.disabled: Free clips aren't available right now. Pick a plan and I'll clip this one in full.
refused.team: Free clips are for personal accounts. Pick a plan and I'll clip this one in full.
refused.not_needed: Your plan already covers this. Hit the arrow and I'll get started.
refused.unavailable: Free clips aren't available right now. Pick a plan and I'll clip this one in full.

making.started: On it! I'm watching the whole video to find the moments worth posting.
making.wait: This takes a few minutes. Feel free to look around, I'll email you when it's ready.
making.failed: Hmm, I couldn't finish that one. It happens with some videos. Want to try another?

ready.best: Done! Your best moment: **“{hook}”**. It scored {score} out of 100.
ready.bestNoHook: Done! Your first clip is ready.
ready.more: {count, plural, one {I found one more moment in this video. It's ready to make, it just needs a plan.} other {I found # more moments in this video. They're ready to make, they just need a plan.}}

paid.thanks: You're in! Making the rest of your clips now, right here.

choose.ask: One last thing: how should home open for you?
choose.allSet: You're all set. Paste another link any time and I'll take it from there.
choose.tryAgent: {count, plural, one {Try Agent (one free message)} other {Try Agent (# free messages)}}
choose.saveFailed: Couldn't save that. You can change it in Settings.

done.bye: That's the tour! I'll pop up when you open something new.

hints.label: Agent
hints.library: Every project lives here. Open one to watch, download or polish its clips.
hints.calendar: Everything you've scheduled, day by day. Drag a post to move it.
hints.social: Link YouTube, TikTok or Instagram once, then post any clip in a click.
hints.analytics: Views and what's working, so your next clips land even better.
hints.settings: Pick your caption style once and every new clip uses it.
hints.assistants: Connect Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor and make clips without opening SupoClip.
hints.clips: The number on each clip is its score: the higher, the more likely it travels. Open one to watch, download or polish it.
hints.studio: Tell the AI what to change, like “cut the ums” or “make it punchier”, and it edits the clip for you.
